mkp-data:reltable@1.name: reltable
mkp-data:reltable@1.about: A relation drawn as a table: a header band, keyed rows that keep their identity between steps, rows marked on washed (and the current one barred), rows marked off struck through, heading rows across, and number columns right-aligned.

inputs.name: cols
inputs.about: the column names (inline Markdown, so maths works)

inputs.name: rows
inputs.about: the rows, each with an id

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: a caption above the table

inputs.name: bar
inputs.about: a bar on the left of the rows marked on: they are the current one

inputs.name: pressable
inputs.about: a row is pressed to pick it

inputs.name: maths
inputs.about: the column names are TeX

values.name: numeric
values.body: len(filter(rows, r => r.mark != head)) > 0 and fold(rows, true, (ok, r) => ok and (r.mark == head or number(at(r.cells, c, "")) == number(at(r.cells, c, ""))))
comment: a column of numbers only is right-aligned and monospaced

values.name: longest
values.body: fold(rows, 0, (a, r) => max(a, if(r.mark == head, 0, len(at(r.cells, c, "")))))
comment: each column's share of the width, by how much it has to say (monospaced numbers are wider); maths
headings are counted short, as they typeset narrower than their TeX

value.expr: if(fit, gridshares(map(range(0, n - 1), c => chars(c))), map(range(0, n - 1), c => 1))
max(1, min(12, fold(spans, 0, (a, w) => a + w)))
map(range(0, n - 1), c => {label: at(cols, c, ""), align: side(c), badge: "", lit: false, span: spans[c], rule: false})

values.name: drawn
values.body: {id: rows[k].id, key: false, glyph: "", gtone: "", gspan: 0, wash: if(rows[k].mark == on, "info", ""), struck: rows[k].mark == off, current: bar and rows[k].mark == on, bar: bar, dim: false, note: "", nspan: 0, across: across, cells: map(range(0, n - 1), c => {v: at(rows[k].cells, c, ""), wash: if(rows[k].mark == on, "info", ""), tone: "ink", glyph: "", gtone: "", outline: false, mono: numeric(c), align: side(c), span: spans[c], rule: false})}

mkp-data:gridrow@1.name: gridrow
mkp-data:gridrow@1.about: One row of a data grid, drawn as it is marked: a gutter with its id and its mark's glyph, its cells, a note at its end; washed in a tone, struck through, faded, or current with a bar on its left.

inputs.name: row

mkp-data:gridshares#0.src: map(range(0, len(ws) - 1), i => gridfloor(ws[i], gridwhole(ws)) + if(indexof(gridextra(ws), i) >= 0, 1, 0))

mkp-data:gridextra#0.name: gridextra
